summary: Prepare compressed scale planes through the fused-MoE weight API
compatibility: Install the paired vLLM/B12X CSF preparation changes. Canonical CSF checkpoint files and launch commands remain compatible.
details: CsfScalePlanes carries rank-local CPU fixed and exception tensors; prepare_weights creates resident scale batches and retains the ordinary weight and scale preparation paths.
CSF checkpoint readers and tensor-store interfaces are removed from B12X; vLLM owns file access, model mapping and TP slicing.
Scale decoders, expert kernels and shared scratch ownership are unchanged.
